# Hapn

> Hapn is a college events website that helps students discover upcoming workshops, competitions, hackathons, cultural events, and other college activities, with registration links provided by event organizers.

Hapn is a public, mobile-friendly website. Event listings and event details are presented to students without requiring a public login. Registration is handled through external Google Forms when provided by an event organizer.

The site is built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on the frontend, with Supabase used for authentication, database storage, file storage, and row-level security. The repository is hosted on GitHub and the production website is served at https://hapn.info/.

## Public Pages

- [Hapn home](https://hapn.info/): Main landing page and featured/upcoming events.
- [Events](https://hapn.info/events.html): Browse and filter public college events.
- [About](https://hapn.info/about.html): Information about Hapn.
- [Help](https://hapn.info/help.html): Help and usage information.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://hapn.info/terms.html): Terms governing use of Hapn.
- [Sitemap](https://hapn.info/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public indexable pages.
- [Robots](https://hapn.info/robots.txt): Crawler guidance and sitemap location.

## Event Information

Event pages may be rendered from event data stored in Supabase. Event information can include the event title, description, date/time, venue, category, poster/image, registration link, and registration status. Event registration links may point to Google Forms or another external registration destination supplied by the organizer.

## Technical Context

- Production site: https://hapn.info/
- Source repository: https://github.com/Arbaj-k/College-Event-site
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Backend: Supabase
- Hosting/deployment: Netlify
- Registration: Google Forms or organizer-provided external registration links
